entities.name: SERVICE ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by the network in response to SERVICE REQUEST, EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST, or CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST messages. Direction is from network to UE.

entities.name: Protocol discriminator
entities.description: Identifies the protocol type. Mandatory field in SERVICE ACCEPT message.

entities.name: Security header type
entities.description: Specifies the security header format. Mandatory field in SERVICE ACCEPT message.

entities.name: Service accept message identity
entities.description: Identifies the message type as SERVICE ACCEPT. Mandatory field.

entities.name: EPS bearer context status
entities.description: Indicates the status of EPS bearer contexts. Optional field in SERVICE ACCEPT message.

entities.name: T3448 value
entities.description: GPRS timer value used for timing control. Optional field in SERVICE ACCEPT message.

entities.name: EPS additional request result
entities.description: Provides additional results for EPS requests. Optional field in SERVICE ACCEPT message.

relations.description: SERVICE ACCEPT message includes Protocol discriminator as a mandatory information element.
SERVICE ACCEPT message includes Security header type as a mandatory information element.
SERVICE ACCEPT message includes Service accept message identity as a mandatory information element.
SERVICE ACCEPT message optionally includes EPS bearer context status information element.
SERVICE ACCEPT message optionally includes T3448 value information element.
SERVICE ACCEPT message optionally includes EPS additional request result information element.
